run_release_docs: run the release_docs script to branch wiki pages for a new gtest version
create_wiki_branch: create versioned wiki page branches for a specified gtest or gmock release version
update_wiki_links: update interlinked wiki references in branched files to point to versioned pages
get_files_to_branch: get the list of .wiki files that need to be branched excluding unversioned and already-versioned pages
drop_wiki_suffix: drop the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename to get the base page name
